name: wallet-stack
title: Wallet Stack
description: Glint Cards tucked in a stitched leather pocket: tap to fan them out, with the balance counting up.

perf.budget: Opening and closing is one UI-thread spring shared by every card. The Glint Cards follow the finger (no motion sensors) while the wallet is open; closed, nothing animates.

measurements.notes: Frames are measured while opening and closing: the wallet grows in height (a layout pass per frame) for about 0.6 s per toggle; framestats show ~6 ms of app work, the rest the emulator GPU. Closed or open at rest, nothing animates.

a11y.reducedMotion: The wallet opens and closes without springing, the balance shows at once and the cards hold a still reflection (Glint Card).
a11y.screenReader: The pocket is a button reading the title and balance, with a hint to show or tuck the cards; cards are buttons only while the wallet is open.
a11y.touchTarget: The pocket is about 190 pt tall; open cards are full width and 150 pt tall.

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { WalletStack } from '@/components/kinetik/wallet-stack';

<WalletStack
  balance={account.balance}
  cards={account.cards.map((c) => ({ id: c.id, name: c.product, last4: c.last4 }))}
  onCardPress={(card) => router.push(`/cards/${card.id}`)}
/>;
```

## When to use

- A wallet or accounts overview with two to four cards and one total.

## When not to use

- Many cards: the pocket shows up to four. Use a list or Parallax Carousel.
- Showing full card numbers: faces show the name and last four digits only.

## Notes

- Each card is a Glint Card: while the wallet is open, the light follows your finger across a card (no motion sensors, so opening stays smooth). Pass your own `background` gradients to match real card designs; no card-network logos are drawn.
- Cards are only tappable while the wallet is open; tapping the pocket opens and closes it.
- The balance counts up when it changes; cents show quieter after the whole amount.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add wallet-stack`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
